name: GLBA Financial Privacy & FTC Safeguards Rule Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (GLBA) and FTC Safeguards Rule (16 CFR Part 314), covering nonpublic personal information (NPI) encryption, multi-factor authentication, incident response, and annual CISO reports.

checklists.name: GLBA FTC Safeguards Rule Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for FTC Safeguards Rule §314.4 requirements covering NPI protection and risk assessment.

items.statement: Nonpublic Personal Information (NPI) is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3) per §314.4(c)(3).
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is enforced for any individual accessing NPI per §314.4(c)(5).
Service provider risk assessment and contractual security mandates are enforced for external vendors (§314.4(f)).
Annual CISO written report is presented to the Board detailing security posture and risk assessments (§314.4(i)).

reviewGates.name: GLBA Safeguards Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The CISO attests that NPI technical safeguards, MFA enforcement, and vendor monitoring satisfy GLBA FTC Safeguards Rule standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the security assessment confirm full compliance with GLBA FTC Safeguards Rule requirements?
